header: From first SDK call to first funnel report
description: Most teams have a working funnel on the day they sign up. You don't design a data model first: send events with the names your team already uses.

items.title: Send one event
items.description: Add the JavaScript or mobile SDK and call track once. The event appears in the live stream within 12 seconds.

items.title: Name what matters
items.description: Mark the four or five events that make up a signup or a checkout. Nothing else needs labelling before you can query.

items.title: Build the funnel
items.description: Pick the steps in order, set the conversion window and read the drop-off. Median build time in new workspaces is under 5 minutes.
